'''blown away Ralltiir Rage''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[blown away]]
* '''Published:''' 14 June 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 ROps away DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Blaster Rack (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Reactor Terminal (V), The Emperor (V), Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (V), Blizzard 1 (V), Blizzard 2 (V), Fear (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

A Character based RalOps deck that revolves around controlling and dealing out huge damage from Ralltiir.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the deck.

* 1x {{CardLink|No Escape (Dark)|Ref3-D-noescape.gif|label=No Escape}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Leave Them To Me (Dark)|Ref3-D-leavethemtome.gif|label=Leave Them To Me}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Come Here You Big Coward (Dark)|Ref3-D-comehereyoubigcoward.gif|label=Come Here You Big Coward}}
* 1x {{CardLink|You've Never Won A Race?|Ref3-D-youveneverwonarace.gif}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Weapon Of A Sith|Ref3-D-weaponofasith.gif}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Secret Plans (Dark)|Ref3-D-secretplans.gif|label=Secret Plans}}

The starting section names six Defensive Shields after Fear Is My Ally (No Escape, Leave Them To Me, Come Here You Big Coward, You've Never Won A Race?, Weapon Of A Sith, Secret Plans) plus 'Three other shields'; the six are dested outside the deck.

== Notes ==

* Qty 61 as published (no section counts). Secret Plans sits in the run of shields, so it is the Reflections III shield here; Reactor Terminal (V), listed after it, is counted in the deck.
* Original-era (V): Blaster Rack (V) (Virtual Set 1); Reactor Terminal (V) (Virtual Set 3); Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Set 4); Fear (V) (Virtual Set 5); Ability, Ability, Ability (V), The Emperor (V), Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* ovs_pick returned a Virtual Set 7+ page for Blizzard 1 (V) (Virtual Set 17) because sets 7+ are treated as legal from 2004-06-01; the code comment says 'only after 2004', so the newest Virtual Set 1-6 printing is used: Blizzard 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4).
* Posted Prefects office dested Spaceport Prefect's Office; Kir Kandos dested Kir Kanos; U3PO dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio). Maul's Lightsaber posted plain, so it is Maul's Lightsaber.

== Strategy ==

At the start of the game the focus should be to get as many powerful characters to Ralltiir as possible.  Use Blaster Rack (v) to pull matching sabers and other weapons.  If you do not have Emperor on the table when you flip that should be the first card you pull using in the hands of the emperor.  With all of the powerful characters and react ability in this deck it shouldn't be too difficult to dominate 3 Ralltiir sites. Get Overseeing personally on the Emperor to add to the drains.  Between Lightsabers and overseeing it personally drains should be massive.  Playing Mosep in the middle of Ralltiir also can cause serious problems to your a opponents ability to deal with the drains.  Hutt Smooch and Lt. Pol are their to deal with Undercover spies, and Death Mark is used to draw opponent to Ralltiir or place on Han in a Profit deck.

I included Guri and Stinger, to help deal with a Hidden base deck.

The Podrace should be used later in the game when it is unexpected.
